ruleDefinitions.name: UAC Bypass Using Disk Cleanup
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the pattern of UAC Bypass using scheduled tasks and variable expansion of cleanmgr.exe (UACMe 34)

sequences.query: (process_command_line = RGX("\\"\\\\system32\\\\cleanmgr\\\.exe\\ \\/autoclean\\ \\/d\\ C\\:$") AND parent_process_command_line = "C\:\\Windows\\system32\\svchost\.exe\ \-k\ netsvcs\ \-p\ \-s\ Schedule" AND (process_integrity_level = "High" OR process_integrity_level = "System" OR process_integrity_level = "S\-1\-16\-16384" OR process_integrity_level = "S\-1\-16\-12288"))
